"Create a complete 2D pixel-art farming and life simulation RPG inspired by the gameplay style of Stardew Valley.

IMPORTANT: The game must use the same type of gameplay structure and perspective as Stardew Valley, not 3D and not a side-scrolling platformer.

GAME DESIGN:

- 2D top-down pixel-art graphics.
- Tile-based world and environment.
- Four-direction character movement.
- Farming, planting, watering, and harvesting.
- Different crops for each season.
- A living village with unique NPCs.
- NPC friendship, dialogue, gifts, and personal stories.
- Fishing with different fish species.
- Mines with monsters, ores, and treasures.
- Crafting and resource gathering.
- House upgrades and furniture customization.
- Animals such as chickens, cows, sheep, and ducks.
- Day and night cycle.
- Four seasons and changing weather.
- Festivals and village events.
- Inventory, tools, equipment, and storage chests.
- Quests and a long original storyline.
- A large explorable map with farms, forests, beaches, caves, and villages.

ORIGINAL CONTENT:

Create a completely original world, characters, names, locations, music, pixel-art assets, and story. Do not copy Stardew Valley's characters or assets.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Fully playable 2D game.
- Smooth animations and movement.
- Mobile-friendly touch controls.
- Save and load progress.
- Proper menus and user interface.
- Functional gameplay systems, not just mockups.
- Optimize for Android devices.

The final result should feel like a complete farming life simulation game with the charm and gameplay depth of Stardew Valley.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, original, playable 2D top-down pixel-art farming life simulation inspired structurally by Stardew Valley.

## Requirements
- Top-down 2D perspective with tile-based environments and four-direction movement.
- Functional farming, seasons, NPC relationships, fishing, mining, crafting, housing, inventory, day/night, weather, quests, menus, save/load, and touch controls.
- Original characters, locations, assets, story, and branding.
- Mobile-friendly and optimized for Android.
- Fully playable rather than a mockup.

## Decisions
- Created an original game titled “Hearthwild.”
- Used a canvas-based 2D pixel-art implementation with a web UI.
- Implemented local browser saves through `localStorage`.
- Adopted a single large explorable top-down map with farm, village, beach, forest, and mine regions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the full HTML application shell and mobile-responsive layout.
- Added CSS styling for the pixel-art game, side panel, inventory, journal, hotbar, touch controls, and modals.
- Implemented the canvas top-down world renderer.
- Added player movement, collisions, directional facing, tools, animation, and camera following.
- Added crop planting, watering, growth, harvesting, seasons, rain, and day advancement.
- Added NPC dialogue, friendship, gifts, and an original storyline.
- Added fishing, mining, ore, crafting, seed buying, house rest/upgrade, storage, and inventory selling.
- Added save/load, calendar, weather, energy, time, gold, quests, and multiple UI tabs.
- Added mobile virtual movement and action controls.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- Functional QA and visual verification were not recorded as completed in the conversation.
- The implementation may need further runtime testing for edge cases and rendering issues.

## Next Move
1. Run the game using `start.sh` and verify it in a browser.
2. Test movement, planting, watering, harvesting, talking, fishing, mining, crafting, sleeping, saving, and loading.
3. Take screenshot checks, including a compact mobile viewport.
4. Fix any runtime or interaction issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `[index.html]`: Main game UI and application markup.
- `[game.css]`: Responsive visual styling and mobile controls.
- `[game.js]`: Complete game systems, renderer, state, menus, and persistence.
- `[start.sh]`: Starts the local development server.
- `[capture.sh]`: Captures the running game for visual verification.

## Important Context
- Primary game state is held in the `state` object inside `game.js`.
- Save data is stored under the `localStorage` key `hearthwild-save`.
- The crop, NPC, season, tool, and item systems are all defined in `game.js`.
- `node --check game.js` passed successfully.
- The app is in the workspace root at `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.

## Objective
- Complete and verify “Hearthwild,” an original, playable top-down pixel-art farming life simulation.

## Requirements
- Four-direction movement and tile-based environments with farming, seasons, NPC relationships, fishing, mining, crafting, housing, inventory, day/night, weather, quests, menus, save/load, and touch controls.
- Original characters, locations, assets, story, and branding; mobile-friendly and optimized for Android.

## Decisions
- Canvas-based 2D web game with local browser saves under `hearthwild-save`.
- One explorable map spanning farm, village, beach, forest, and mine regions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game UI, renderer, movement, tools, farming, NPCs, fishing, mining, crafting, housing, inventory, quests, calendar, save/load, and mobile controls.
- `node --check game.js` passed before the latest edits.
- Captured desktop and mobile screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/hearthwild-desktop.png` and `/tmp/opencode/hearthwild-mobile.png`; both rendered.
- Browser smoke check confirmed title, Day 1, and initial energy; switching to Hoe and using it reduced energy from 100 to 97.

### Active
- Fix and verify gameplay edge cases; the latest changes to `game.js` are uncommitted.

### Blocked
- Full interaction QA remains incomplete; the smoke check did not confirm watering, harvesting, NPC interactions, or the remaining systems.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` after the latest edits.
2. Use browser testing to validate planting, watering, growth/harvesting, fishing, mining, NPC dialogue, crafting, sleeping, and save/load.
3. Fix any issues found and recheck desktop and mobile rendering.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, systems, renderer, UI, and persistence.
- `index.html`: Application shell and controls.
- `game.css`: Responsive styling and mobile controls.
- `start.sh`: Development server launcher.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture launcher.

## Important Context
- Latest `game.js` edits add tool-specific energy checks, preserve the prior day when advancing crops, grant daily eggs when the coop is built, and include tomatoes, pumpkins, and eggs in sale proceeds.
- Browser smoke check showed the watering action did not visibly reduce energy; investigate whether the simulated input or watering interaction explains this.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Complete and verify Hearthwild, an original, playable top-down pixel-art farming life simulation.
- Continue QA on gameplay systems, edge cases, and mobile controls.

## Requirements
- Include movement, farming, seasons, NPC relationships, fishing, mining, crafting, housing, inventory, day/night, weather, quests, menus, save/load, and touch controls.
- Keep the game original, mobile-friendly, and optimized for Android.

## Decisions
- Use a canvas-based 2D web game with local browser saves under `hearthwild-save`.
- Use one explorable map spanning farm, village, beach, forest, and mine.

## Work State
### Completed
- Core game systems and UI were implemented; earlier browser QA verified planting/watering, crop growth and harvest, NPC dialogue/friendship, seed purchases, fishing, mining, and save persistence.
- Added chest/fence state migration, placement, rendering, and chest deposit/withdraw interactions.
- Added separate mobile `USE` and `ACT` buttons in `index.html`, wired to tool use and interaction in `game.js`.
- Connected Lina’s dialogue to ore delivery and added a story-state guard against duplicate delivery.
- Added Craft tab UI for chest, fence, and coop recipes, and routed recipe buttons through `craftItem()`.
- Hardened placement checks and nested save migration for inventory, crops, tilled/watered state, friendship, animals, quests, unlocks, chests, and fences.
- `node --check game.js` passed before the latest visual pass.
- Chromium headless screenshots were captured at `/tmp/hearthwild-desktop.png` and `/tmp/hearthwild-mobile.png`; `--dump-dom` showed the game and UI rendered.

### Active
- Review crafting/placement edge cases, including resource deductions and coop egg timing.
- Verify browser behavior for crafting, chest/fence placement and storage, save/load migration, selling, calendar, Lina delivery, and touch controls/layout.
- Investigate chest deposit/withdraw handling and coop once-per-day egg production.

### Blocked
- Browser automation packages (`playwright`, `puppeteer`, `selenium-webdriver`) were not found via `require.resolve`; interactive browser tests are still pending.

## Next Move
1. Inspect Craft-tab markup and test or reason through resource checks, recipe results, and coop egg production.
2. Run targeted browser QA using available tooling; confirm chest/fence placement and storage, save/load, selling, calendar, Lina delivery, and mobile controls.
3. Re-run `node --check game.js` and inspect the captured desktop/mobile screenshots; address remaining responsive or console issues.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, gameplay systems, dialogue, crafting, rendering, UI, and persistence.
- `index.html`: Application shell and mobile controls.
- `game.css`: Responsive styling and mobile controls.
- `/tmp/hearthwild-desktop.png`: Captured desktop screenshot.
- `/tmp/hearthwild-mobile.png`: Captured mobile screenshot.
